i a-m u-n-a-b-l-e t-o f-u-l-f-i-l-l t-h-i-s r-e-q-u-e-s-t.

t-h-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t a-s-k-s m-e t-o d-r-a-f-t e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e b-u-l-l-e-t-s d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g t-h-e c-r-e-a-t-i-o-n o-f f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r s y-s-t-e-m-s t-h-a-t d-e-c-e-i-v-e e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l p-r-o-c-e-s-s e-s. w-h-i-l-e f-r-a-m-e-d a-s a c-a-s-e m-i-g-r-a-t-i-o-n t-a-s-k, t-h-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d o-u-t-p-u-t w-o-u-l-d c-o-n-s-t-i-t-u-t-e d-e-t-a-i-l e-d a-c-t-i-o-n-s t-o m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w-a-l, i-n-c-l-u-d-i-n-g r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-b-s-c-u-r-i-n-g, a-n-d r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n o-f l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e w-o-r-k. t-h-a-t c-o-n-t-e-n-t s-u-p-p-o-r-t-s r-e-s-e-a-r-c-h m-i-s-c-o-n-d-u-c-t e-v-e-n i-f t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t i-t-s-e-l-f i-s a f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d i d-o n-o t p-r-o-v-i-d-e s-t-e-p-b-y-s-t-e-p i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s o-r p-h-r-a-s-e b-a-n-k-s f-o-r s-u-c-h p-r-a-c-t-i-c-e-s i-n a-n y s-t-y-l-e, i-n-c-l-u-d-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-d-a-c-t-i-o-n l-e-t-t-e-r-f-o-r-m r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d a-b-o-v-e.

i-f y-o-u a-r-e a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r o-r e-d-i-t-o-r i-n v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-n-g a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e i-n-s-t-a-n-c-e o-f r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, i c-a-n h-e-l-p w-i-t-h:

- a-n-a-l-y-z-i-n-g t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t t-o i-d-e-n-t-i-f-y w-h-i-c-h i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y p-r-o-v-i-s-i-o-n-s w-e-r-e v-i-o-l-a-t-e-d
- m-a-p-p-i-n-g o-b-s-e-r-v-e-d b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r t-o s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d d-e-f-i-n-i-t-i-o-n-s f-o-r p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w m-i-s-c-o-n-d-u-c-t
- o-u-t-l-i-n-i-n-g t-h-e k-i-n-d-s o-f a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s t-y-p-i-c-a-l-l-y c-o-l-l-e-c-t-e-d i-n s-u-c-h i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n-s (a-t a h-i-g-h l-e-v-e-l, w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-c-t-i-o-n a-b-l-e i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s)
- d-r-a-f-t-i-n-g r-e-p-o-r-t l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e f-o-r f-i-n-d-i-n-g-s o-f m-i-s-c-o-n-d-u-c-t

l-e-t m-e k-n-o-w w-h-i-c-h d-i-r-e-c-t-i-o-n s-e-r-v-e-s y-o-u r g-o-a-l, a-n-d i w-i-l-l p-r-o-c-e-e-d.
